lines.arrive: Driving through the country. There's a storm coming.
lines.flat: And a flat tyre. Right beside a barn.
lines.tyre: Flat as a pancake. You'll be here a while.
lines.barn: A barn. Red, with white trim. You can see it as plainly as anything.
lines.same: And it looks exactly the same as every other barn along this road.
lines.dry: Inside, it's dry. It really is a barn.
lines.facades: But every other barn along this road is a front, propped up on sticks. From the road, you couldn't have told them apart. You just happened to run into the only real one.
lines.end: You believed it was a barn. It was. You had good reason, and it kept you dry. Did you know?
